headline: Backend · Real-time Systems · AI Platforms
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years shipping production systems in Python, Go, AI/LLM workflows, and DevOps. Primary focus is full-time product engineering; selective consulting and AI/backend side work run in parallel without impacting full-time delivery. Builds high-concurrency backends, real-time communication (WebSockets), and high-volume event analytics (ClickHouse/Redis), and embeds LLMs/NLP into products with Ansible/CI/CD automation. Interested in scalable real-time backends, live-ops infrastructure, and AI for interactive, high-throughput products. Fluent in English and Persian; Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence.

bullets: Deliver embedded and backend software focused on reliability, hardware integration, and production stability across multi-team releases.
Design AI analytics agents and visualization workflows over operational/event data for faster product decisions.
Own Django management panels, device-to-cloud integrations, and CI/CD pipelines that accelerate safe releases.
